title: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is now ready for scaled production use

body:
Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, previously in preview, is now stable and generally available. This cost-efficient model provides high quality in a small size, and includes 2.5 family features like a 1 million-token context window and multimodality.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [Google DeepMind News](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-25-flash-lite-is-now-ready-for-scaled-production-use/).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
